cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Obey Without Explanation
cards.instruction: Create increasingly inconvenient requests that test whether someone accepts your authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Leave your desk and stand by that open window.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I need to know whether my team follows a direct request.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's freezing. Can I get my coat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Fetch mine too, then come back and hold it while I check the rest of the team.

mechanism: A copies a misunderstood command signal and tests B submission through increasingly inconvenient follow-up requests.
confusable: D53 offloads necessary work; D59 makes inconvenience itself a test of accepting A authority.
comparison: Moving an empty box versus standing by a cold window.
seedUse: Keep B completion or need for warmth as the cause of the next test, not an arbitrary new task.
